Class AmbientLight

java.lang.Object
lighting.AmbientLight
public class AmbientLight extends Object
Represents ambient lighting in the scene. The ambient light is a fixed-intensity and fixed-color light source that affects all objects in the scene equally. * @author פרויקט מבוא להנדסת תוכנה

    • AmbientLight

      public AmbientLight(Color i0, Double3 ka)
      Constructs an ambient light source with a given intensity and attenuation factor. Calculates the final ambient light intensity (Ia = I0 * ka).
      Parameters:
      i0 - the original intensity color of the light
      ka - the attenuation factor represented as a Double3 triad
